title: Accessible Web Interfaces
description: Semantics, keyboard behavior, contrast, focus, and feedback.

questions.prompt: Color alone is enough to communicate whether an answer is correct.
questions.explanation: Use text and icons alongside color.

questions.prompt: Which element is the best default for opening a question navigator?
questions.explanation: A native button provides keyboard and assistive-technology behavior.

questions.prompt: Which HTML attribute provides a text alternative for an informative image?
questions.explanation: The alt attribute supplies the text alternative.

questions.prompt: What should happen when a user prefers reduced motion?
questions.explanation: Reduced-motion preferences should minimize decorative movement.
